correctness.rationale: For degree d>=3p, Chinese remaindering modulo product of (X-a)^3 gives independent, uniform Hasse jets at all p residue classes. Taylor expansion modulo p cubed separates simple roots and rare singular cases; the field quadratic census supplies exactly the five local outcomes and works in characteristic two. Independently enumerated all 262144 monic degree-six polynomials modulo eight and their full distribution; quadratic counts verified for primes 2,3,5,7,11. Exact local moments and the third-moment identity were also recalculated; general proof does not depend on experiments.

value.rationale: The full root-count probability law at the first modulus with a quadratic singular-lifting stage is a natural next question for squarefree local models, not determined by the known mean and variance or the previous square-level distribution. The new p-squared root branch yields an exact divergent third moment and p^(2k-5) high-moment phase, despite Poisson(1) weak convergence. These provide structural data for later local random-polynomial and higher-power studies, without claiming an unrestricted polynomial or all prime-power theorem.
